svg.title: Reading Kern Fig. 25 (water in tubes): h_i at 3.37 ft/s, 79 °F
svg.text: Reading Kern Fig. 25 (water in tubes): h_i at 3.37 ft/s, 79 °F
Redrawn from h_i = 150(1 + 0.011 t) V^0.8 / d_i^0.2 for the 0.62 in ID (¾ in 16 BWG) tube; curves are water temperature, °F
Water velocity in tubes, V, ft/s
Mark the water velocity V = 3.37 ft/s on the bottom axis.
Go straight up to the 79 °F curve (water temperature; interpolate between the printed curves).
Go across to the h_i axis on the left.
Read h_i ≈ 800 Btu/(h·ft²·°F) — the solution’s (Kern’s book) reading; this redraw gives 815 (hollow circle).
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
Kern prints this chart for one tube size with an ID correction factor; here the curves are computed for d_i = 0.62 in.
